commit.message:
K217 Lean: the dominated AX routine as a checked macro word

L2AxiomsDom (the 217's AX routine, node 236 of dagDom) still used the per-node renderer: for each of the 160 chain nodes an effect fN, run lN, cleanliness cN and an untrusted closed form eN checked by simp, 1,196 lines. The 215's L2AxiomsPerm already uses a checked macro word: one run induction composes the macro contracts along the word, decide +kernel binds the word to the literal program, and one symbolic evaluation proves ax_eval. dagDom's node 236 has the same shape (a linear chain of the same register macros ending in the gate at 457), and L2Dom already transfers every macro contract from dag222, so the Dom output now comes from the same template with its Perm identifiers renamed.

generate_l2axiomsdom.py renders that one template for both programs and loses the per-node renderer and its symbolic simulator (487 -> 215 lines); its perm output is still byte-identical to the committed L2AxiomsPerm.lean. L2AxiomsDom: 1,196 -> 161 lines; f236, l236, c236 and ax_eval keep their statements, and l236/ax_eval keep [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Its two outputs differ only in the AX word (the 215 and the 217 read their fields in different orders).

Checked: serial per-module lake build of the 18 stale modules of L2RootDom's closure, ending with L2AxiomsDom and its client L2RootDom, all green. Not rebuilt: SeedDom and KEndpoint217 (SeedDom also needs Seed222 -> L2Axioms222, stale here); they use only L2RootDom's unchanged statements. No pinned K215 file is touched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
